title: AI avatars
subtitle: Choose by how much likeness you want to keep
heading: AI avatar prompts: choose by how much likeness you want to keep
seoTitle: AI Avatar Prompts: Circle Logo, Bot Icon and Storybook Portrait | Image Prompt Book
lead: All three need a reference photo. They differ in how much of the person they keep: a side-profile inside a circle logo, a flat robot face, or a storybook character that still has your hair, clothes and glasses.

symbol.title: You only need a recognizable mark

likeness.title: You want people to still see you

circle-logo-avatar.why: It draws a side face or a pet's head as a Japanese-minimal logo inside a solid black circle. The mark stays readable even when it is tiny.
circle-logo-avatar.goodFor: Social avatars and a personal brand mark
circle-logo-avatar.notFor: Any place where the face and expression have to be clear
circle-logo-avatar.adjust: Palette: white on black, ivory on ink, or white on vermilion

grokbot-capsule-icon.why: It turns a person or character into a flat 2D robot face with two black capsule eyes. This is the one with the most options you can change.
grokbot-capsule-icon.goodFor: An AI product face, or a matching set of team avatars
grokbot-capsule-icon.notFor: A portrait that should still look like you at a glance
grokbot-capsule-icon.adjust: Face color, blush, background, crop, tilt, coloring and outline

storybook-character-portrait.why: It keeps the real hair, clothes and glasses, then redraws the person as a storybook character with a round head, rosy cheeks and gouache-and-crayon texture.
storybook-character-portrait.goodFor: A warm personal avatar for family or education

choose: If the avatar has to stay readable at a very small size, start with the circle logo — it keeps only the outline.
If you want a shared character look and you are willing to tune it, use the bot icon. Its seven option groups cover color, crop and outline.
If friends should still recognize you, use the storybook portrait. It keeps hair, clothes and glasses.
caution: All three need you to attach a photo in the image tool. This site does not upload or generate images.
